# Ahmed Moustafa (أحمد مصطفى)

> Healthcare IT Manager (مدير تقنية المعلومات الصحية) specializing in digital health and Revenue Cycle Management in Saudi Arabia. Works on hospital information systems (HIS), NPHIES integration and AI in healthcare. Shares Arabic educational content about health IT and health AI.

## Main pages
- [Portfolio (English)](https://a7mdmoustafa.github.io/): profile, experience, platforms and skills
- [Portfolio (Arabic)](https://a7mdmoustafa.github.io/ar/): الملف المهني بالعربية

## Current work
- Leading the RCM implementation at King Saud University Hospital, Riyadh (CORE Transformation).
- RCM go-lives delivered: King Abdulaziz University Hospital (Jeddah), King Fahad Medical City, King Fahad Hospital of the University, MOD Hospitals.
- [FAQ on healthcare IT, RCM, NPHIES and healthcare AI](https://a7mdmoustafa.github.io/#faq)
